title: real test counts per runner
size and route the milestone review
lint feature steps at init
a given-up feature doesn't end the run
note: lanes: a given-up feature ends only its own lane; dependants wait

title: verify never trusts the cache
verify and merge a finished milestone at the deadline
don't retry a session that stopped on a permission question with nothing changed
cap and stop each session's processes
Re-run failed test files serially before declaring the suite red or un-passing a feature
Record per-step evidence rows from verify sessions in entries.jsonl so step re-runs can be audited
Extend step lint at init to flag self-contradictory steps (e.g. 'A untouched' vs 'conflict reported')
Run the project's CLAUDE.md memlint check inside the session's own end-of-session gate, so a Gotchas overflow is caught before the driver's suite
Tell sessions in the prompt that entries.jsonl/progress-archive.md are driver-only, so the driver need not restore them
Cap or warn on session suite runs: sessions ran the full suite 2-7x at 800 s each (CLAUDE.md says ~210 s)
verify, resume, retro and initializer reverts: compute the base as the merge-tree of the session start and origin/main
note: Not done in decisions/2026-10-30-lane-guard-base (PR #70). Dormant: do it if harness-log.md ever shows '<id>: the session merged main into its branch itself' outside a coding lane.

title: a merge that makes the run's own record tracked overwrites the slot's ignored copy
note: Not done in decisions/2026-10-30-lane-guard-base (PR #70). Only the prompts/coding.md rule (never merge main into the branch) prevents it; same trigger as restrict-merge-tree-base.

title: a --base branch carrying .harness/runs/ changes main lacks has them reverted by lane_guard
note: Not done in decisions/2026-10-30-lane-guard-base (PR #70). Matters only if a run is started with --base on such a branch; drop if --base is never used that way.

title: Back off and collapse record-branch push-failure log lines
Rework the CLI's verbiage and command syntax to be human-oriented: remove duplication and improve clarity (harness queue add --continue is not intuitive)
note: Michael, 2026-11-07: not immediate. The whole surface, not one command: naming, option shapes, duplicated paths that do the same thing, and wording that reads as internal jargon. harness queue add --continue <run> is the worst example - a continue is not an add.

title: Rename the project from 'harness' to an 'orchestrator' across GitHub, the local checkout, docs, prompts and command names
note: Michael, 2026-11-07: not immediate. What was built is an orchestrator, not a harness, and every name should say so. Touches the GitHub repo name, the local path, CLAUDE.md, README, docs/, prompts/ and the CLI's own name. Do it with, or after, cli-verbiage-and-syntax so the surface is renamed once.

title: Move off GitHub to Codeberg or a self-hosted Forgejo, and keep the merge path (gh pr merge) working behind whatever replaces it
note: Michael, 2026-11-07: long-term want, recorded when he accepted the ORIGIN_TRY_TIMEOUT default (dispatch Decision 5 item 1). The harness reaches the origin through gh and git in lib/record.sh (origin_try), so the provider is a seam worth naming before it is hard-coded further.

title: A run that ends with a re-base pending opens a needs card, not just a log note
note: Michael, 2026-11-07: accepted as a fix at dispatch Decision 5 item 2 (F1's review finding 4). Today the note goes to run.log only, so the run can end needing attention with nothing that asks for it; the other three Decision 5 defaults were accepted as they are.

title: A REVIEW_MODEL config key for a review under the opus line, so the cheap reviewer can be fable instead of the hard-coded sonnet
note: Michael, 2026-11-07: he wants no sonnet in the loop and asked for 'opus, or fable' reviewers. lib/lane.sh:429 hard-codes `mdl=$(F model sonnet)` for a review under REVIEW_OPUS_LINES, so the only lever today is REVIEW_OPUS_LINES=0 (every review goes opus), which is what the user config now does. The knob would restore a two-tier review: REVIEW_MODEL=fable under the line, opus at or over. It also needs lib/lane.sh:503's escalation condition, which compares the chosen model against $(F model sonnet), to compare against REVIEW_MODEL instead, or a cheap review that finds something would stop escalating.

title: After a verify failure, re-verify only the failed steps on the retry's fix instead of closing the lane as nothing left to try
